initialUserRequest: 始まりの谷のアセットを全地域で使い回さず、各地形にふさわしい3Dモデルをそれぞれ制作して使用する。時間をかけてよい。
latestUserDirection: 基本モデルを地域間で使い回してメモリを節約する。雪は元モデルに重ねる。地域ごとの見た目と配置を適切にする。
implementation: Reuse accepted TRELLIS base geometry, texture objects and LODs; add shared regional material variants and biome-appropriate placement.

regions.snow: Source-shaped snow on pines, rocks, wood, bushes, tent roof and hearth rim
regions.ice: Frost/cold rock surfaces and compact snowy shelter; no pine forest or grass
regions.volcano: Dark rock and charred wood with ash; no green vegetation
regions.desert: Warm stratified rock, dry grass, bleached wood and lower hide shelter; no pines

sharing.additional: Regional materials/uniforms, per-instance transforms, and 256px far-view renders of resident regional vegetation

unusedProductionHistory.generation: TRELLIS attempt stopped after the user clarified base reuse; partial output retained

limitations: Snow is a coating of the existing source surface, without extra snow thickness or collision volume.
This change does not add new terrain GLBs; the existing region-specific grounds, glaciers and volcanic cones are retained.
Runtime allocations are not zero: the shared base prevents model duplication while small regional rendering resources are added.
